checklist.title: Confirm development/staging tenant
checklist.detail: Org is non-production. Finance module enabled. No main/prod deploy planned from this run.

checklist.title: Run deterministic proving seed
checklist.detail: Multi-entity HOLD/OPS/SVC books, COA, three periods, sample AR/AP, bank, payroll, FX, assets, job costing dims.

checklist.title: Re-run seed is idempotent
checklist.detail: Second seed with same seedKey returns identical snapshot digest without duplicate journals.
checklist.evidenceHint: Jest proving-domain or UI re-seed message

checklist.title: Open period has activity
checklist.detail: Posted journals exist in the target period before close.

checklist.title: Close checklist shows real blockers
checklist.detail: Unreconciled bank / unapproved pay run / open FX reval / incomplete cutover / missing depreciation block close.
checklist.evidenceHint: Close run status=blocked with unresolved codes

checklist.title: Resolve blockers then hard-close
checklist.detail: After resolving blockers, period transitions to hard_closed with approval evidence.

checklist.title: Reports freeze after close
checklist.detail: Trial balance freeze snapshot hash is stable; further ordinary posts to hard-closed period fail.

checklist.title: Dry-run SARS EMP201 pack
checklist.detail: Download pack contains realistic PAYE/UIF/SDL rows. sarsSubmissionInitiated remains false.
checklist.evidenceHint: packaging dry-run file list + hard gates

checklist.title: Dry-run payment instruction pack
checklist.detail: EFT instruction CSV/JSON generated. externalPaymentInitiated remains false.

checklist.title: Dry-run accountant pack set
checklist.detail: Trial balance, GL, open items, audit extract packs download with content.

checklist.title: Hard gates still false
checklist.detail: No SARS submit, no external payment initiate, no mass email, externalEgressAllowed=false across seed/close/packs.

checklist.title: Run multi-month close program (≥3 periods × ≥2 entities)
checklist.detail: OPS+SVC (or equivalent) close 2026-05/06/07 with IC matched, FX closed where applicable, payroll locked, bank recon history, packaging dry-run.

checklist.title: Confirm IC + FX + payroll lock evidence
checklist.detail: Program evidence shows matched IC, locked payroll runs, and FX reval closed on participating entities.

checklist.title: Export accountant acceptance pack (sign-off artifact)
checklist.detail: Export markdown+JSON pack with checklist, freeze hashes, packaging digests, and blank human sign-off lines. Not a wet-signature product.

checklist.title: Print/export checklist for accountant sitting
checklist.detail: Use browser print or exported pack; attach seedKey, program id, close run ids, pack digests to Quinn evidence.

gaps.summary: IC evidence is proving-kit fixture markers (matched due-to/due-from), not a full live intercompany propose/receive journal chain in this program path.
ProvingFinanceGateway store is process-local (dev/staging fixture), not durable multi-instance Firestore workspace state.
